prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1263; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear quarter panel and bumper cover show the main damage, and most of it lines up with a side-swipe impact at a left turn. The left rear door has creased areas that will need straightening and refinishing, and the tail lamp housing is cracked. We found no sign of earlier damage on the vehicle. Two similar charges entered on the same day are still being verified with the shop. The labor hours look slightly high for the work described, so we are asking the shop to review them before approval. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover, repair and repaint the quarter panel, and replace the lamp housing.
